title: The Weight of Becoming
narrationStatus: guide-audio-only-local-render; approved Chatterbox not yet produced

scenes.headline: THE STRANGE THING
scenes.narration: Here's the strange thing about getting what you wanted.

scenes.headline: YOUR DREAM
scenes.narration: Some mornings, your dream looks exactly like another deadline.

scenes.headline: THE DOOR OPENED
scenes.subhead: NOW YOU HAVE TO WALK THROUGH
scenes.narration: The door you begged to open now asks you to show up.

scenes.headline: A BIGGER LIFE
scenes.narration: You asked for a bigger life, not the weight that came with it.

scenes.headline: YOU WISHED
scenes.narration: You wished for change, then missed the comfort you left behind.

scenes.headline: NEW CHANCES
scenes.narration: You wanted new chances.

scenes.headline: LONG NIGHTS
scenes.narration: They arrived disguised as long nights and hard work.

scenes.headline: RISE HIGHER
scenes.narration: You asked to rise higher.

scenes.headline: NOT QUIETLY
scenes.narration: But growth doesn't arrive quietly.

scenes.headline: PRESSURE
scenes.narration: Sometimes it feels like pressure.

scenes.headline: RESPONSIBILITY
scenes.narration: Responsibility.

scenes.headline: EXPECTATIONS
scenes.narration: Expectations.

scenes.headline: A NEW VERSION
scenes.narration: And a version of yourself you haven't met yet.

scenes.headline: YOU DIDN'T
scenes.narration: That doesn't mean you chose wrong.

scenes.headline: THE OLD MAP
scenes.narration: It means the old map isn't big enough anymore.

scenes.headline: EXPANSION
scenes.narration: Before it makes sense, expansion can feel like everything breaking.

scenes.headline: DISCOMFORT
scenes.narration: But discomfort isn't always a warning.

scenes.headline: YOUR LIMITS
scenes.narration: Sometimes it's your limits moving out of the way.

scenes.headline: OLD HABITS
scenes.narration: Old habits stop fitting.

scenes.headline: OLD EXCUSES
scenes.narration: Old excuses get harder to believe.

scenes.headline: NEW STANDARDS
scenes.subhead: A NEW WAY TO SEE YOURSELF
scenes.narration: Even your standards begin to change.

scenes.headline: WHEN YOU'RE TIRED
scenes.narration: So when you're exhausted, remember what you're building.

scenes.headline: WHEN YOU DOUBT
scenes.narration: When you doubt yourself, remember what you survived.

scenes.headline: YOU ONCE HOPED
scenes.narration: You once hoped to stand in this very place.

scenes.headline: YOU'RE BECOMING
scenes.narration: You're not falling apart. You're becoming someone new.
